title: The theorem needs no intuition about duplicates

statements.text: Unlike Swampman cases, which elicit an intuition about a duplicate, and unlike the unfolding argument, which reaches only theories reading consciousness from causal organization, the theorem derives an inconsistency from local-state sufficiency and causal efficacy alone. It assumes no functionalism and takes no position on the metaphysics of time.

sources.quote: It appeals to no intuitions about duplicates, assumes no functionalist commitment, and takes no position on the metaphysics of time.
